profile.headline: Software Engineer at GovCIO
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working on web-based and mobile applications. Skilled in Java, JavaScript, Android, PostgreSQL, Spring, and Kubernetes. Strong full-stack engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from Salisbury University.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
●	Developed a transportation scheduling application to improve route and dispatch demands.
●	Designed a clean and simple user application interface for intuitive interactions to maintain optimal workflow.
●	Wrote documentation for end-users and system administrators to communicate scheduling software capabilities and characteristics. Documented the architecture and algorithms necessary for Shore Transit scheduling operations.

honors.title: Code for Good 2nd Place (Delaware 2016)
honors.description:
●	Implemented a mobile web application to achieve Accelerate Delaware's mission to provide a community for young professionals to engage in meaningful relationships that advance social and civic growth in Delaware.

●	Built using Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, MySql, JavaScript.
honors.issuer: Issued by JPMorgan Chase & Co. · Oct 2016

honors.title: Eagle Scout Award
honors.description:
●	Led a team to construct and install fifteen man-made animal houses and an educational display at a public park under tight project deadlines.
●	Budgeted and raised money required to successfully execute the project and ensured adherence to financial targets by researching, planning, and finalizing proposals for every aspect of the project.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Feb 2009
